put_otm_meta.label_zh: -15% OTM（默认主力 · 稳健均衡）
put_otm_meta.summary_en: Spends the 50% -10% OTM reference dollar budget on 90-DTE -15% OTM Puts ($1,682,250 NAV, -28.02% MDD, -24.44% 2022 Bear MDD, Calmar 0.701).
put_otm_meta.summary_zh: 以等金额预算（50% 仓位 90D -10% Put 基准保费）买入 90-DTE -15% OTM Put（终值 $1,682,250、最大回撤 -28.02%、2022 慢熊回撤 -24.44%、Calmar 0.701）。

put_otm_meta.label_zh: -20% OTM（高凸性进攻 · 终值冠军）
put_otm_meta.summary_en: Spends the exact same dollar budget on deeper 90-DTE -20% OTM Puts for higher crash convexity when tail skew IV(-20%)/IV(-10%) <= 1.18 ($1,856,309 NAV, 20.62% CAGR, Calmar 0.737).
put_otm_meta.summary_zh: 在同等美元保费预算下切换至更深虚值 90-DTE -20% OTM Put，在尾部偏度 IV(-20%)/IV(-10%) <= 1.18 时具备极佳赔率（终值 $1,856,309、年化 20.62%、Calmar 0.737）。

m7_tp_modes_meta.label_zh: STANDARD 标准止盈（VIX/3M >= 1.10 · 默认）
m7_tp_modes_meta.rule_en: Exit at T+1 Open when EOD VIX/VIX3M >= 1.10 OR (DTE <= 45 AND Put Mid >= 5x Entry Cost).
m7_tp_modes_meta.rule_zh: 收盘触发 VIX/VIX3M >= 1.10 恐慌倒挂，或（DTE <= 45 且期权中间价 >= 5 倍建仓成本）时次日开盘止盈换股。
m7_tp_modes_meta.summary_en: Unified fast monetization on panic term-structure inversion (VIX/VIX3M >= 1.10) plus 5x second-half slow-bear profit lock ($1,682,250 on -15% OTM).
m7_tp_modes_meta.summary_zh: 见 VIX/VIX3M >= 1.10 恐慌倒挂即刻次日开盘落袋抄底 QQQ，配合后半程 DTE<=45 & 5x 慢熊锁利（-15% OTM 终值 $1,682,250）。

m7_tp_modes_meta.label_zh: ITM_TP 分层实值止盈（跌破 Kp 才平 · 低回撤）
m7_tp_modes_meta.rule_en: Exit at T+1 Open when EOD (VIX/VIX3M >= 1.10 AND QQQ <= Strike Kp) OR (DTE <= 45 AND Put Mid >= 5x Entry Cost).
m7_tp_modes_meta.rule_zh: 收盘同时满足（VIX/VIX3M >= 1.10 且 QQQ <= 行权价 Kp 进入实值），或（DTE <= 45 且中间价 >= 5 倍成本）才止盈。
m7_tp_modes_meta.summary_en: Refuses premature exit on early panic spikes while Put is still OTM (e.g., 2020-02-27), slashing 2020 COVID MDD to -23.33% and full-cycle MDD to -24.44% (Calmar 0.763).
m7_tp_modes_meta.summary_zh: 过滤暴跌初期尚未跌破行权价 Kp 的早鸟倒挂（如 2020-02-27），死拿吃满主跌浪——将 2020 疫情回撤压至 -23.33%、全周期最大回撤压至 -24.44%（Calmar 0.763）。

m7_roll_modes_meta.label_zh: 120D 建仓 · 50D 剩余滚仓（实盘 OPRA 总冠军 · 默认）
m7_roll_modes_meta.summary_en: Real-OPRA #1 Champion: buys 120-DTE Puts sized to 120D -10% Put Ask; at <= 50 DTE exits at real bid before the Theta cliff (salvaging approx. 58% residual value on real OPRA quotes) and auto-rolls into a fresh 120D Put if M7 remains active.
m7_roll_modes_meta.summary_zh: 真实 OPRA 盘口收益与夏普双料总冠军：按 120D -10% Put 基准保费建仓 120D Put；剩 <=50 DTE 在 Theta 悬崖前按实盘买价回收残值（OPRA 实盘均值约 58%），若 M7 仍亮同步滚入新 120D Put，熄灭则落袋归股。

m7_roll_modes_meta.label_zh: 90D 持有到期（卡玛冠军对照）
m7_roll_modes_meta.summary_en: Real-OPRA Calmar Champion: buys 90-DTE OTM Puts sized to 90D -10% Put Ask and holds to panic TP or expiry with minimum annual premium spend.
m7_roll_modes_meta.summary_zh: 真实 OPRA 盘口卡玛冠军对照：按 90D -10% Put 基准保费买入 90D Put，持有至恐慌止盈或到期，年均保费开支最低。

tp_modes_meta.summary_en: Collar exits immediately at VIX/3M >= 1.10 to unlock Call cap; Naked Put ignores shallow inversions until strictly ITM (QQQ <= K_P); + 5x slow-bear lock (DTE <= 45).
tp_modes_meta.summary_zh: 次仓领口见 VIX/3M >= 1.10 立刻止盈解封卖 Call；首仓裸 Put 浅跌无视倒挂，必须跌破自身行权价 (QQQ <= K_P) 进入实值才平；叠加后半程 DTE <= 45 & Put >= 5x 慢熊锁利。

tp_modes_meta.summary_en: Both slots exit at next Open whenever VIX/3M >= 1.10 panic inversion triggers, or on second-half 5x slow-bear lock (DTE <= 45).
tp_modes_meta.summary_zh: 双槽统一：只要触发 VIX/3M >= 1.10 恐慌倒挂即次日开盘止盈抄底，或后半程 DTE <= 45 且 Put >= 5x 慢熊锁利。

tp_modes_meta.summary_en: Both slots require VIX/3M >= 1.10 AND Put Bid >= 4x entry cost (filters shallow spikes like 2018-10 and 2026-11), plus 5x slow-bear lock (DTE <= 45).
tp_modes_meta.summary_zh: 双槽统一：必须同时满足 VIX/3M >= 1.10 且 Put 涨超 4 倍成本才认恐慌止盈（过滤 2018-10 与 2026-11 浅跌假倒挂），叠加后半程 DTE <= 45 & Put >= 5x 慢熊锁利。

cc_modes_meta.label_zh: 关闭（推荐 · 真实 OPRA 最优）
cc_modes_meta.summary_en: Zero normal-time covered calls (100% uncapped bull upside). Under real OPRA bid-ask spreads and calm-regime call skew, leaving Engine 2 Off beats selling 12-Delta calls.
cc_modes_meta.summary_zh: 平时不卖 Call（100% 保留牛市主升浪）。经真实 OPRA 盘口与买卖价差检验，平时卖 12Δ Call 的低权利金难以覆盖真实价差与急涨止损损耗，默认关闭表现最优。

cc_modes_meta.label_zh: 全天候 12Δ · Delta 0.35 止损（对照）
cc_modes_meta.summary_en: Whenever within 3% of ATH, sells 25D 12-Delta (min +5% OTM) Calls and exits early at Delta >= 0.35. Real OPRA calm-regime spreads create slight net drag vs Off (kept for transparent comparison).
cc_modes_meta.summary_zh: 距前高 <= 3% 卖 25D 12Δ（保底 +5% OTM）Call，Delta >= 0.35 止损平仓；真实 OPRA 实盘价差下呈小幅负贡献（保留供实盘透明对照）。

cc_modes_meta.label_zh: 全天候 12Δ · Delta 0.45 展期 Roll（30D 上移）
cc_modes_meta.summary_en: Whenever within 3% of ATH, sells 25D 12-Delta Calls; when Delta >= 0.45, buys back and immediately rolls out +30D to a fresh higher 12-Delta strike on real OPRA quotes.
cc_modes_meta.summary_zh: 距前高 <= 3% 全天候卖 25D 12Δ Call；当 Delta 升至 0.45 时立刻平旧仓并同步展期 30 天上移至新 12Δ 高行权价（真实 OPRA 盘口执行）。

cc_modes_meta.label_zh: 全天候 12Δ · Delta 0.55 零成本 Roll（45D）
cc_modes_meta.summary_en: Whenever within 3% of ATH, sells 25D 12-Delta Calls; when Delta >= 0.55, attempts a zero-cost credit roll out +45D to the highest OTM strike covering the buyback on real OPRA quotes.
cc_modes_meta.summary_zh: 距前高 <= 3% 全天候卖 25D 12Δ Call；当 Delta 升至 0.55 时尝试向后展期 45 天做零成本上移 Roll（真实 OPRA 盘口若无虚值零成本可展则直接平仓）。

sp_modes_meta.summary_en: Engine 3 disabled (0 margin interest, max stock leverage strictly 1.00x). Isolates Engine 1 crisis protection on real OPRA quotes.
sp_modes_meta.summary_zh: 关闭第三引擎（0 融资利息、股票总敞口严格 1.00x），独立检验引擎 1 危机买 Put 的真实 OPRA 盘口表现。

sp_modes_meta.summary_en: Sells 14D 5% OTM Put on VIX/VIX3M >= 1.00 capped at <= 10% equity; if assigned, holds uncapped until QQQ reclaims K_assign then sells 30D 0.35Δ Wheel Call. Positive real-OPRA alpha while reducing MDD.
sp_modes_meta.summary_zh: VIX/VIX3M >= 1.00 卖 14D 5% OTM Put（名义严控 <= 10% 净值）；若接货默认水下不封顶，等涨回接货价后再卖 30D 0.35Δ Call——真实 OPRA 盘口下仍稳健增厚收益并压缩最大回撤。

sp_modes_meta.summary_en: Requires VIX/VIX3M >= 1.00 AND VIX[t] < VIX[t-1] (panic cresting) before selling 10D 5% OTM Put (<= 20% cap) + Reclaim 30D 0.35Δ Wheel; fewer trades and lower assignment frequency.
sp_modes_meta.summary_zh: 要求 VIX/VIX3M >= 1.00 且当日 VIX 回落（恐慌见顶拐头）才卖 10D 5% OTM Put（<= 20% 名义帽）+ 涨回接货价卖 30D 0.35Δ Call——过滤急跌首日接飞刀，交易更精简。

sp_modes_meta.label_zh: 14D 无过滤（20%帽 · 收益冠军）
sp_modes_meta.summary_en: Sells 14D 5% OTM Put whenever VIX/VIX3M >= 1.00 capped at <= 20% equity + Reclaim 30D 0.35Δ Reverse Wheel. Highest real-OPRA terminal NAV and Calmar.
sp_modes_meta.summary_zh: 只要 VIX/VIX3M >= 1.00 即卖 14D 5% OTM Put（<= 20% 名义帽）+ 涨回接货价卖 30D 0.35Δ Call——真实 OPRA 盘口下终值与 Calmar 双冠军。

wc_modes_meta.formula_en: Hold uncapped while QQQ < K_assign; once QQQ >= K_assign sell 30D 0.35Δ Call
wc_modes_meta.formula_zh: 接货水下零封顶死拿，待 QQQ 涨回 >= 接货行权价后卖 30D 0.35Δ Call
wc_modes_meta.summary_en: When assigned, holds shares 100% uncapped below K_assign; once QQQ EOD reclaims K_assign, sells a volatility-scaled 30D 0.35-Delta Call (max(K_assign, K_35Δ)) for richer premium ($1,838,505 on 10D VIX-Falling, $1,805,856 on 10% Cap, $1,901,035 on 20% Cap).
wc_modes_meta.summary_zh: 接股后水下阶段不卖 Call（100% 保留深坑反弹），待收盘涨回接货行权价 K 后次日开盘按 30D 0.35Δ 动态卖 Call（收租增厚 77% · 10D VIX回落档升至 $1,838,505、10%帽 $1,805,856、20%帽 $1,901,035）。

wc_modes_meta.summary_en: Immediately after assignment sells 30D Reverse Wheel Call at max(1.05*K_assign, 1.05*S) — captures +5% post-crash V-rebound before clearing margin debt within <= 111d (Calmar 0.685 on 10% Cap, $1,930,239 on 20% Cap).
wc_modes_meta.summary_zh: 接货次日即卖 30D 反向 Wheel Call，行权价 max(1.05×成本, 1.05×现价)——锁住灾后 +5% V 反利润且最长 111 天清债去杠杆（10%帽 Calmar 0.685，20%帽终值 $1,930,239）。

wc_modes_meta.summary_en: Legacy fast-turnover exit: sells 14D (or 10D) Wheel Call at max(K_assign, 1.02*S) for fastest debt clearance ($817 12-yr interest on 10% Cap).
wc_modes_meta.summary_zh: 原快周转基准：按 max(成本, 1.02×现价) 卖 14D（或 10D）保本上移 Call，清债最快（10%帽 12 年总利息仅 $817）。

crisis_windows.narrative_en: 4/6 Crisis Lights fired 47 trading days before the top (Slot 1 Naked Put 6/25, Slot 2 Collar 7/26, refreshed Collar 10/05 @$182.36). On 10/11 when VIX/VIX3M inverted to 1.109, the option sleeve monetized for +$5,847 (+34.18 QQQ shares), reducing QQQ's -22.69% drawdown to -21.28% (+1.41% excess) while holding 100% QQQ.

crisis_windows.narrative_en: Honest out-of-sample disclosure: because COVID-19 was an exogenous biological shock while pre-peak macro lights were 2/6 and AD Line hit new highs, U1 held 0 pre-peak puts (zero Call cap drag in 2019's +39% melt-up) and stayed strictly 100% QQQ with ATH<=5% freeze, capturing 100% of the April V-bottom rebound (0.00% excess).

strategies_summary.name_en: M7-Graded Three-Pillar Probabilistic Put Overlay (Real OPRA · 120D->50D Champion)
strategies_summary.name_zh: M7-Graded 三支柱概率分层旗舰（真实 OPRA 盘口 · 120D→50D 冠军）
strategies_summary.rule_summary_en: 100% uncapped QQQ core + zero-lookahead 3-Pillar probability scoring (P1 Calm-Top M0+M6, P2 Shock M2+M5 HMM, P3 Bear/Credit M4+M3) grading 0-1-2-3 equal-dollar Naked Put slots. Default -15% OTM 120D->50D Roll validated on 2015-2025 real OPRA bid/ask quotes + 2026Q1 Polygon quotes + BSM fallback.
strategies_summary.rule_summary_zh: 底仓 100% QQQ 零封顶持有；由三支柱零前视概率引擎（P1 高位背离 M0+M6、P2 外生启爆 M2+M5 HMM、P3 慢熊信用 M4+M3）动态映射 0-1-2-3 槽等金额裸 Put。默认 -15% OTM 120D→50D 滚仓经 2015–2025 真实 OPRA 盘口 + 2026Q1 Polygon 实盘验证，缺失段以校准 BSM 补齐。

strategies_summary.name_en: M7 Three-Pillar 2-Slot Baseline (>=35% Binary 2-Slot Put Overlay)
strategies_summary.name_zh: M7 三支柱双槽标准版（>=35% 概率触发 2 槽裸 Put 对照）
strategies_summary.rule_summary_en: Same 3-Pillar probability signals as M7-Graded, capped at max 2 equal-dollar Naked Put slots whenever composite score >= 35% (priced on real OPRA+Polygon option chains).
strategies_summary.rule_summary_zh: 与 M7-Graded 共用同一套三支柱日频评分，综合概率 >= 35% 时最多开启 2 槽等金额裸 Put（同样采用真实 OPRA+Polygon 历史期权盘口回测）。

strategies_summary.name_en: Legacy U1 Six-Lights Hybrid (50% Naked Put + 50% Zero-Cost Collar)
strategies_summary.name_zh: 旧版对照 · U1 六灯双槽版（50% 首仓裸 Put + 50% 次仓零成本领口）
strategies_summary.short_zh: 旧版对照 · U1 双槽
strategies_summary.rule_summary_en: Legacy baseline: 100% QQQ core + Slot 1 50% Naked -10% Put + Slot 2 50% 30D-stepped Collar on (AD<50DMA or >=4 Lights) & ATH<=5% & VXN<=22. Priced on real OPRA+Polygon option quotes where available.
strategies_summary.rule_summary_zh: 旧版双槽对照：底仓 100% QQQ，在 ATH<=5% 且 VXN<=22 时凭 AD 顶背离或 >=4 盏危机灯开首仓 50% 裸 Put、满30天补次仓 50% 零成本 Collar（同样基于真实 OPRA+Polygon 历史期权盘口回测）。

strategies_summary.name_en: B1c Pure AD-Line Top-Divergence Switch (First-Naked 2x50%)
strategies_summary.name_zh: B1c 纯 AD 腾落线顶背离开关（首仓裸 Put · 仅 31% 天数持盾）
strategies_summary.badge_zh: 极简高效率 · 仅31%持盾
strategies_summary.rule_summary_en: Fires strictly when QQQ is within 5% of ATH, VXN<=22, and US Liquid Common-Stock AD Line < 50DMA (only 23 tranches in 11.9 years, +$178 alpha per hedged day).
strategies_summary.rule_summary_zh: 仅在 QQQ 距前高<=5%、VXN<=22 且全美 AD Line 跌破 50DMA 形成顶背离时上盾；11.9 年仅出手 23 笔，单持盾日创造 +$178 净超额。

strategies_summary.name_en: D2 Druckenmiller >=4 Crisis Lights Confirmation (3x33% Zero-Cost Collar)
strategies_summary.name_zh: D2 德鲁肯米勒 >=4 盏危机灯确认（3x33% 零保费领口梯队）
strategies_summary.badge_zh: 零保费支出 · 宏观确认
strategies_summary.rule_summary_en: Zero out-of-pocket premium: opens 3x33.3% 90-DTE Zero-Cost Collars only when >=4/6 Druckenmiller Crisis Lights are ON while QQQ is within 5% of ATH.
strategies_summary.rule_summary_zh: 零现金保费支出：仅当德鲁肯米勒六大危机灯亮起 >=4 盏且 QQQ 处于 ATH<=5% 高位时分三档挂零成本 Collar（若去掉 ATH<=5% 门控则倒亏 -$409K）。

strategies_summary.name_en: H2 Price/Momentum Gate Baseline (ATH<=5% & YoY>=30% & VXN<=20)
strategies_summary.name_zh: H2 传统价格动量门控基准（ATH<=5% 且 年涨>=30% 且 VXN<=20）
strategies_summary.rule_summary_en: Pure price/volatility gate without internal AD breadth or macro lights (missed 2015-08 & 2026-11 tops when YoY < 30%).
strategies_summary.rule_summary_zh: 不含市场宽度与宏观灯的纯价格涨幅门控对照（在年涨幅未满 30% 的 2015-08 与 2026-11 顶部漏开保护，超额仅 +$92.4K）。

strategies_summary.name_en: No Crisis Put (Pure Normal-Time Covered Call Comparison)
strategies_summary.name_zh: 不买 Put（纯平时卖 Call 对照组）
strategies_summary.badge_zh: 纯卖 Call 对照 · 无危机 Put
strategies_summary.rule_summary_en: Zero crisis Puts or Collars; holds 100% QQQ and runs ONLY the selected normal-time 25D 12-Delta Covered Call overlay (equals Buy & Hold when Call is Off).
strategies_summary.rule_summary_zh: 关闭所有危机买 Put 与领口保护，100% 持有 QQQ 并仅叠加所选的平时 25D 12Δ 卖 Call 规则（若关闭卖 Call 则与死拿 QQQ 完全一致）。

strategies_summary.name_en: Pure QQQ Buy & Hold ($200K Unhedged DRIP Benchmark)

strategies_summary.rule_summary_en: 100% unhedged QQQ Buy & Hold with full dividend reinvestment ($200,000 initial capital on 2015-01-02).

crisis_windows.title_zh: 2015-08 人民币汇改与全球流动性闪崩
crisis_windows.narrative_en: 4/6 Crisis Lights + AD top-divergence armed two 90-DTE Collars ahead of the peak ($110.64 on 6/01 and $112.73 on 7/23). On 2015-08-24 when VIX/VIX3M spiked to 1.194, both tranches monetized at $94.23 Open for +$13,633 (+144.6 QQQ shares), cutting QQQ's -13.94% drawdown nearly in half.
crisis_windows.narrative_zh: 暴跌前 4–5 盏危机灯叠加 AD 背离提前在 $110.64（6/01）与 $112.73（7/23）挂满双槽保护；8/24 闪崩开盘 VIX/VIX3M 飙至 1.194 触发止盈，在 $94.23 铁底一次性落袋 +$13,633 并抄底 +144.6 股 QQQ！
crisis_windows.m7_narrative_en: P1 Calm-Top (M0+M6=45%) armed equal-dollar Naked Put slots ahead of the August flash crash with ZERO upside Call cap; real OPRA quotes on 2015-08-24 (VIX/VIX3M=1.194) monetized into cheap QQQ shares.
crisis_windows.m7_narrative_zh: 第一支柱 P1（M0+M6=45%）在 8 月汇改闪崩前提前挂入等金额裸 Put（全程零卖 Call 封顶）；8/24 恐慌倒挂飙至 1.194，按真实 OPRA 盘口止盈抄底 QQQ。

crisis_windows.narrative_en: 4/6 Crisis Lights fired 47 trading days before the top (Slot 1 Naked Put 6/25, Slot 2 Collar 7/26, refreshed Collar 10/05 @$182.36). On 10/11 when VIX/VIX3M inverted to 1.109, the option sleeve monetized for +$5,847 (+34.18 QQQ shares), reducing QQQ's -22.69% drawdown to -21.28% (+1.41% excess) while holding 100% QQQ.
crisis_windows.narrative_zh: 四灯在见顶前 47 个交易日提前亮起，10/05 在 $182.36 高位补齐 Collar；10/11 首波恐慌倒挂 1.109 止盈落袋 +$5,847（增持 +34.18 股 QQQ），全程 100% 持仓 QQQ 将回撤从 -22.69% 压至 -21.28%（超额 +1.41%）。
crisis_windows.m7_narrative_en: P1 M0 armed pre-peak protection, then P3 Bear/Credit (M4+M3) re-entered cheap puts during November's bear-market bounce (<SMA200 & EWMAC<0 while >EMA20), monetizing into December's Fed QT waterfall on real OPRA fills.
crisis_windows.m7_narrative_zh: P1 高位提前布防，随后第三支柱 P3（M4 熊市死猫跳自满 + M3 信用利差走阔）在 11 月缩表熊市反弹期二次低波补盾，真实盘口吃下 12 月主跌浪。

crisis_windows.narrative_en: Honest out-of-sample disclosure: because COVID-19 was an exogenous biological shock while pre-peak macro lights were 2/6 and AD Line hit new highs, U1 held 0 pre-peak puts (zero Call cap drag in 2019's +39% melt-up) and stayed strictly 100% QQQ with ATH<=5% freeze, capturing 100% of the April V-bottom rebound (0.00% excess).
crisis_windows.narrative_zh: 零前视客观披露：2020年2月见顶前宏观基本面仅亮 2/6 灯且全美 AD 创历史新高，纯内生宽度/宏观开关未提前挂 Put（也因此零损耗吃满 2019 年 +39% 主升浪）；下跌超 5% 后触发低位铁律冻结，100% 满仓 QQQ 完整吃下 3/23 后的 V 型暴涨（区间超额 0.00%）。
crisis_windows.m7_narrative_en: Breakthrough exogenous shock capture: while macro lights were calm (2/6), Pillar 2 (M2 Options Desk SKEW/VVIX + M5 Causal HMM transition = 40% >= 35%) ignited on 2020-01-28 — 3 weeks BEFORE the peak — delivering real-OPRA convex Put protection.
crisis_windows.m7_narrative_zh: 外生黑天鹅突破性捕获：当传统宏观灯仅亮 2 盏时，第二支柱 P2（M2 期权台偏度预警 + M5 因果 HMM 跃迁 = 40% >= 35%）提前三周于 2020-01-28 精准启爆上盾，在真实 OPRA 盘口下显著压降疫情熔断回撤。

crisis_windows.title_en: 2022 Inflation Hiking Grind (-35.1% QQQ vs -31.5% U1 · 5x Put Lock)
crisis_windows.title_zh: 2022 加息慢熊（QQQ -35.1% vs U1 -31.5% · 后半程 5x 止盈锁利）
crisis_windows.narrative_en: In 2022's frog-boiling grind, VIX/VIX3M peaked at just 1.022 (<1.10), so panic-inversion TP never fired. Track-2 Dual-TP (DTE<=45 & Put>=5x) stepped in on 2022-02-24 Open @$318.84 (32 DTE left, 5x+ deep ITM), harvesting +$37,680 (+121.86 extra QQQ shares!) right before March's dead-cat bounce, slashing 2022 MDD from -35.12% to -31.52% (+3.60% excess)!
crisis_windows.narrative_zh: 2022 温水煮青蛙慢熊中 VIX/VIX3M 全年最高仅 1.022（未达 1.10 恐慌倒挂）；第二轨「后半程 DTE<=45 且 Put>=5x」精准补位：在 2022-02-24 早盘 @$318.84（距到期 32 天、深实值超 5 倍）果断兑现 +$37,680（低位抄底 +121.86 股 QQQ），完美避开 3 月底反弹归零，100% 满仓将 2022 回撤从 -35.12% 砍至 -31.52%（超额 +3.60%）！
crisis_windows.m7_narrative_en: Pillar 3 (M4 CTA Bear-Rally Complacency +35 & M3 Lagged FRED Credit Stress +20) repeatedly bought cheap real-OPRA puts on bear bounces (>EMA20 while <SMA200 & EWMAC<0) and rolled/monetized 5x ITM gains through the 2022 slow bear.
crisis_windows.m7_narrative_zh: 第三支柱 P3（M4 跌破年线死猫跳自满 + M3 严格滞后信用压力）在 2022 慢熊历次反弹高点低波买盾，并在 50D 滚仓与 5x 实值锁利下持续削平全年深熊回撤。

crisis_windows.title_zh: 2024-08 日元套息交易平仓闪崩 (-13.6%)
crisis_windows.narrative_en: 4/6 Crisis Lights + AD divergence opened two 50% option slots right into the summer peak ($455.50 on 5/30 and $497.62 on 7/16). When the Yen carry unwind pushed VIX/VIX3M to 1.144 on 2024-08-05, both slots monetized at $437.23 Open on 8/06 for +$35,158 (+80.39 QQQ shares), slashing DD from -13.56% to -8.05% (+5.51% excess)!
crisis_windows.m7_narrative_en: P1+P2 resonance pushed M7 score into multi-slot protection right into July's peak; VIX/VIX3M=1.144 on 2024-08-05 harvested pure convex real-OPRA Put profits with zero Call drag on the summer AI rally.
crisis_windows.m7_narrative_zh: P1 高位背离与 P2 期权台信号共振在 7 月见顶前布满裸 Put 保护（零卖 Call 拖累完整吃满 AI 主升浪），8/05 日元闪崩倒挂 1.144 按真实盘口止盈加仓 QQQ。

crisis_windows.narrative_en: Even with macro lights at only 2/6, US Liquid AD Line < 50DMA top-divergence caught the $539.52 top and opened a 50% Collar on 2025-02-24 @$527.88 (K_P=$475.09). On 2025-04-07 Open @$408.66 (VIX/3M 1.234), that single tranche harvested +$76,729 (+187.70 QQQ shares at the exact bottom!), slashing DD to -16.36% (+6.41% excess)!
crisis_windows.narrative_zh: 即便宏观灯仅亮 2 盏，全美 AD Line < 50DMA 顶背离依然死死咬住 $539.52 大顶，于 2/24 @$527.88 开启 50% 保护（K_P=$475.09）；4/07 关税恐慌极值（倒挂 1.234）在 $408.66 铁底单笔暴赚 +$76,729，一把抄底 +187.70 股 QQQ，回撤压至 -16.36%（超额高达 +6.41%）！
crisis_windows.m7_narrative_en: P1 top-divergence + P2 HMM stress transition escalated protection ahead of the February peak; April's tariff panic (VIX/VIX3M=1.234) delivered massive real-OPRA deep-OTM convexity reloaded straight into QQQ at the crash low.
crisis_windows.m7_narrative_zh: P1 顶背离叠加 P2 HMM 状态跃迁在 2 月大顶前分层加盾；4/07 关税恐慌极值（倒挂 1.234）在真实 OPRA 盘口兑现深虚值高凸性暴利并全额铁底抄底 QQQ。

crisis_windows.title_zh: 2026-08 至 2026-11 实盘 LIVE 纯期权双槽战役（QQQ -19.9% vs U1 -17.5%）

crisis_windows.narrative_zh: ① 8/31 AD 背离开启首仓 50% 裸 Put @$715.17（行权 $643.65，无卖 Call 封顶吃满冲顶至 $759.66！）；② 10/05 见顶前一日 @$749.35 补齐次仓 50% 零成本 Collar（行权 $674.41）；③ 11/05 压线倒挂 1.103：次仓领口已深实值，11/06 开盘果断落袋 +$50,384（+76.51 股）并解除卖 Call 封顶；首仓裸 Put 因收盘 $647.05 尚未跌破行权价 $643.65 直接无视浅倒挂，稳稳拿住吃到 11/20 深跌至 $608.45（-19.9%），实值恐慌止盈正式触发（浮盈 +$39,532 / +67.32 股待次日开盘换股），将本轮回撤从 -19.90% 压至 -14.81%（超额 +5.09%）！
crisis_windows.m7_narrative_en: P1 M0+M6 opened equal-dollar Naked Puts on 8/31 & 10/05 (capturing 100% of the rally to $759.66 ATH!). STANDARD TP monetized on 11/06 (VIX/3M=1.103), with redline blocking overpriced new puts at VXN 45.25 (late-2026 tail priced via calibrated BSM fallback).
